meta.title: [alpha_factory] inline WASM assets
meta.body_summary: Inline Pyodide asm and wasm-gpt2 placeholders in the Insight build, expose a base64 Pyodide loader, allow the LLM loader to read a base64 model, and verify Simulator initialization speed.

core_change_summary.description: Inline Pyodide asm and wasm-gpt2 placeholders in build.js; add base64 loading support for Pyodide (lib/pyodide.js) and LLM models (llm.js); add simulator initialization performance test (simulator_perf.test.js) and a Python init test (test_simulator_init.py).
